errors.text: It assigns nucleation to free surfaces, whereas the target bulk periodic model identifies vacancy clusters or disordered atoms as nucleation sites.
It reverses the orientation result: the maximum yield stress is along <-111>, not <110>.
It conflates quaternary FeNiCrMn with quinary CoCrFeMnNi and allows a nanowire/free-surface geometry inconsistent with the target bulk periodic crystal.
The cited evidence concerns CoNiCrFeMn nanowires exhibiting twinning and FCC-HCP transformation, making it inapplicable and partly contradictory to the target system.
Lomer-Cottrell locking, stacking-fault percolation, and temperature-enhanced HCP-like fraction are introduced without target-specific evidence.
